description: Licensed (needs a licence token that owns the part). Returns the part’s module/ files, each marked with the licence and this fetch, plus NOTICE.md where there is one and the licence; and first, save: a link and one shell command that write exactly those files to disk (use it: the files carry invisible markers that copying them out of the reply loses). The files also come as resources. Pin a version to be sure of what you get. Also takes a look id (e.g. splash, with a whole-library licence): the look’s stylesheet, its backdrop where it has one, the shared dials and the plain tokens, and the order to load them in. A look keeps the earlier versions builds were made with: pin one with version (its reply lists them).

id.description: The part id, or a look id.

path.description: Optional: one file of it, as listed in files (e.g. module/charts.ts): returned as plain text, marked, with its SHA-256. For clients that cannot show the files as resources, or a reply too large to read at once.

version.description: Optional: the version to install. A part serves its current version only; a look also serves the earlier versions it keeps (library-<commit>, listed in its reply).

name: install
title: Install a part
